messages:
Sam (CSM): Quick heads up 1: SilverStream QBR is Thursday 9am PT. Need final deck + 1-page follow-up plan by Wed 2pm PT. Short ask list below.

Sam (CSM): Please cover: health snapshot, onboarding milestones, top risks & mitigation, enablement assets, owners for open feedback.

Wei (CS Ops): I'll take health slide 30d show MAU, integration success_runs, and brief incident timeline. Which NPS do we want to cite? product NPS or support CSAT? :thinking_face:

Nora (AE): For execs use product NPS. Renewal posture: sponsor showed interest but usage flat. I'll draft mitigation: exec touch, 2-week success sprint, small credit. Tentative risk score: 44%.

Sam (CSM): Sponsor is "Liam Ortiz" (SVP Eng). Nora, please include a proposed 20-min exec agenda: outcomes, tech wins, sponsor ask.

Diego (Enablement): I'll record a 8-min enablement clip on admin setup + billing checks. Office hours Wed 3pm PT. Will upload recording + 1-pg checklist.

Ivy (SE): For onboarding blockers, running quick adoption queries now. Will paste a short CSV and a one-slide PNG snapshot to the drive. SQL IA0run: 
```sql
SELECT week, active_users, modules_started, modules_completed
FROM adoption_weekly
WHERE account='silverstream'
ORDER BY week DESC
LIMIT 12;
```

Wei (CS Ops): Action items (reply DONE):
- Wei: Health slide (MAU, success_runs, 30d incidents) due Wed 2pm
- Ivy: Adoption CSV + PNG slide due Tue EOD
- Diego: Enablement clip + checklist due Wed 2pm
- Nora: Renewal mitigation slide + exec agenda due Wed 2pm
- Sam: One-page followup + speaking bullets due Wed 2pm

Nora (AE): Can SEs include a perf dashboard screenshot? small visual helps.

Ivy (SE): Will export perf-snap.png to /drive/silverstream/qbr/assets and anonymize quotes.

Wei (CS Ops): Capturing feedback owners: billing -> Diego, API docs -> Ivy, admin UX -> Sam. I'll add to "Open Asks" slide with ETA.

deck-bot: Reminder set: deck snapshot at Wed 14:00 PT. Please upload final slides.

Sam (CSM): Thanks team  if we close these actions early we can lower the risk before the QBR. Ping here if blocked. :thumbsup:
